chunk.label: Compression
chunk.description: translate the full inflate module as a single frozen-anchor chunk

notes: Curated frozen inflate anchor now performs real zlib stored-block expansion instead of returning the input unchanged.
Unsupported block kinds safely fall back to the original payload so staged compile consumers keep deterministic behavior.

metadata.repair_thought_process: Replaced the old identity placeholder with a concrete stored-block zlib decompressor that actually reads bytes, validates the header and materializes output. Unsupported formats intentionally degrade to a safe copy of the input instead of crashing the staged pipeline.
